audit.title: Intake rejects owner-only (restriction) encrypted files
Redact boxes use unrotated MediaBox, land wrong on rotated/CropBox pages
Redact search misses phrases split across text items
Every render reopens + copies the whole file (large-file cost)
audit.reason: no per-render copy counter; large scans now render (JPX fixed in U1), see time and heap on pdf2img-bible-62MB, pdf2img-crooked-104MB, split-911-large

audit.title: Redact re-parses the source per untouched page
audit.reason: internal cost; covered indirectly by redact timing

audit.title: Compress: lossless only / Maximum rasterizes text
pdf-lib intake rejects damaged files viewers open
Stamps/edits ignore rotation, CropBox and MediaBox origin
Only WinAnsi fonts: non-Latin text throws
OCR English only, assets from CDN (not offline)
OCR re-OCRs born-digital pages, no deskew, fixed DPI
Merge/split drop outlines, AcroForm, links
Crop rejects rotated, ignores box origin
Edit is overlay-only
audit.reason: feature gap (no text editing API to call)

audit.title: PDF to Word interleaves columns, no borderless tables, RTL
PDF to Excel number parsing loses leading zeros / formats
PDF to PPT slides are flat images, fixed slide size
Office to PDF quick mode is screenshots (no text)
HiFi engine from unpinned CDN, font substitution
audit.reason: CDN pinning is a config review item; font fidelity not scored

audit.title: pdf.js without cMapUrl / standard fonts / wasm
Forms: XFA not handled, slow widget map
Protect: comma in password splits MuPDF options
Image to PDF: EXIF, HEIC, pixel-as-point page size
Sign is visual only, one placement
audit.reason: feature gap (no PAdES / multi-place API to call)

audit.title: Redact rasterizes whole pages (size balloons)
Repair rebuild drops outlines/AcroForm/metadata
Compare by page index only; inserted page breaks the rest
HTML to PDF is a screenshot, head styles dropped
Split/batch outputs and ZIP all in memory
audit.reason: memory profile of very large splits not measured in U0

audit.title: assertValidOutput re-parses outputs with pdf-lib
Unlock: one password per batch, MuPDF docs not destroyed
audit.reason: per-file password is UI only; destroy() leak not measured

audit.title: Watermark centring is a 45 degree approximation
audit.reason: centring at non-45 angles not measured

audit.title: Page numbers: no skip/template/Bates
Organize renders all thumbnails at once
audit.reason: UI thumbnail batching not driven in U0

audit.title: Upload grid: no rotate/sort/add
No result screen / chaining
Files lost on tool switch / Escape
audit.reason: UI navigation behaviour not driven in U0

audit.title: No cancel, no progress bar
Single-file tools have no batch
Thumbnail cache never evicted
audit.reason: memory over a long session not measured

audit.title: Single pdf.js queue delays user ops
Self-test uses only synthetic fixtures
